executable_or_data_hash_policy: A source tree, manual, storefront ID, reviewed emulator or retail version label cannot substitute for an executable and content fingerprint.

edition_exceptions.subject: Kane’s Wrath on Mac
edition_exceptions.finding: EA groups the expansion with Tiberium Wars in a retired-service heading. A Mac-specific release, media ID or package is needed before treating it as a separately shipped edition.

edition_exceptions.subject: Collective bundles, localisation, censorship, console emulation releases
edition_exceptions.finding: The First Decade, Ultimate Collection, regional dubbed/edited data and emulated digital reissues may affect executable, presentation or missions. Record actual product ID, language, asset hashes and differences before inheriting a row.

edition_exceptions.subject: Cancelled or unshipped designs
edition_exceptions.finding: Tiberium FPS, the cancelled 2013 Command & Conquer/Generals 2 project and unused source definitions remain outside the shipped-unit denominator; dedicated provenance required for influence.
